name: W Mexico City
insider_take: Mexico City's boldest design hotel sits in the heart of Polanco, where contemporary luxury meets vibrant Mexican culture in spectacular fashion.
whats_special: The W Mexico City occupies a stunning 57-story tower designed by renowned architect César Pelli, making it one of the tallest buildings in Latin America. Located in upscale Polanco, you're steps from Presidente Masaryk Avenue's luxury shopping and the world-class Museo Nacional de Antropología. The hotel's rooftop terrace offers breathtaking 360-degree views of the sprawling metropolis and distant volcanoes.
pro_tip: Book a room on floors 50+ for unobstructed views of Chapultepec Park and the historic city center. The sunset views from the Living Room bar are absolutely spectacular and perfect for photos.
dont_miss: The hotel's signature restaurant J&G Grill by Jean-Georges offers innovative Mexican-French fusion cuisine, while the nearby Chapultepec Castle (just a 5-minute walk) provides incredible city panoramas and rich history. Polanco's tree-lined streets house Mexico's best galleries, boutiques, and some of the country's most celebrated restaurants.
pros: Prime Polanco location with easy access to luxury shopping and dining
Signature W brand design with vibrant modern interiors and mood lighting
Rooftop terrace offering panoramic views of Mexico City skyline
Innovative Mexican cuisine at Living Room restaurant and bar
cons: Contemporary lifestyle hotel may not suit traditional luxury preferences
Urban setting in busy Polanco district
